svg.title: Duty cycle of the guide 25 example: flow and pressure versus time
svg.text: Duty cycle of the example job – flow Q(t) and pressure p(t) over one 60 s cycle (extend 5–7 s, retract 17–19 s)

Black = what the cylinder needs. Grey dashed = option A fixed pump 18.9 L/min. Red = option C: 5.4 L/min pump + 5 L accumulator (simulated, adiabatic n = 1.4, PLC refills to cut-out after every movement).
option A pump 18.9 L/min (unloads or goes over the relief when not used)
option C pump 5.4 L/min while charging
relief 11 MPa (option C) – option A relief 10 MPa
accumulator min 8.10 MPa at the end of extend ≥ 7.75 needed ✓
pump only below cut-in 8.1 (no refill after a move):
every 2nd cycle min 7.39 MPa < 7.75 ✗ (extend slows down)
oil per extend 31.17 cm² × 20 cm = 0.623 L
oil per retract 20.99 cm² × 20 cm = 0.420 L
option A: pump for the peak, 3 kW
